##### Project general facts

Central Park Plaza by Meraas is a distinguished residential development in the heart of the city, offering contemporary apartments and townhouses designed to combine modern elegance, comfort, and functionality. The residences feature thoughtfully planned layouts with a strong focus on natural light, spacious interiors, and seamless views of the surrounding park. Townhouses are complemented by raised gardens with private access to the park and landscaped buffers that provide an added sense of privacy.

The development offers a range of world-class amenities designed to support an active and comfortable lifestyle. Residents can enjoy fitness centres, swimming pools, lush green spaces, and direct access to the surrounding park, creating plenty of opportunities for relaxation and outdoor activities. Its vibrant setting also provides convenient access to a wide selection of dining, entertainment, and retail destinations.

The residences feature contemporary interiors enhanced by superior finishes and high-quality materials. Corner panoramic views and full-height glass panels in the bedrooms create bright living spaces overlooking the park, while spacious bathrooms feature a variety of fixtures and high-end materials. The kitchens combine elegant designs with fitted appliances and carefully selected finishes, while the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Wasl, situated in the prestigious City Walk district, is a vibrant and upscale urban destination that effortlessly blends modernity with a touch of classic charm. This dynamic area is renowned for its cosmopolitan atmosphere, world-class shopping, and a myriad of dining options that cater to diverse tastes.

Within Al Wasl, you'll find a harmonious mix of contemporary architecture and lush green spaces, creating an inviting ambiance for residents and visitors alike. Strolling through its pedestrian-friendly streets, you'll encounter a wealth of boutiques, cafes, and cultural attractions that make every visit a unique experience.

Al Wasl is not just a place to live or visit; it's a lifestyle that embodies the spirit of Dubai's cosmopolitan identity. With its central location and a plethora of amenities, it offers a vibrant urban living experience that's second to none.
